_comment: LEGACY flat template. Preferred flow: `crucible inputs VRT --peers ETN NVT MOD POWL` derives every field below from FRED, Yahoo Finance and the filings with citations into data/VRT/analyst_inputs.json, which the packet and model use automatically. Use this file only when you want to hand-type values (pass --analyst analyst_inputs.example.json); every value here is a placeholder.
erp_source: PLACEHOLDER: Damodaran implied ERP <date> or house view
beta_source: PLACEHOLDER: 2-year weekly OLS vs S&P 500 as of <date>
debt_weight_source: PLACEHOLDER: book debt / (book debt + market cap) as of <date>
cost_of_debt_source: PLACEHOLDER: interest expense / average debt, 10-K FY<year>
